spec_match.rationale: Uses the spec's designated detection surface for WGSL language features (navigator.gpu.wgslLanguageFeatures, adapter-free) and distinguishes it from device features — the exact contract for this feature class.

interactive.rationale: Re-enumerate button rebuilds the live card list; the buffer_view card renders present/absent state distinctly.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a full live enumeration with the target highlighted; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles navigator.gpu absent, and the absent-feature state predicts the lab page's compile outcome.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5094091886034944 plus the proposal, spec PR, WGSL extensions section, and samples PR.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts the setlike surface, the registry entry, and registry/compile agreement.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: enumerated the real 4-feature set with buffer_view honestly absent; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: bv-registry-ran asserts with count and target presence.

design_system.rationale: Present card inverts bg/color; absent card dashed with accent-rose on paper (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Cards carry full textual state; list is aria-live; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Card grid collapses under 640px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the present state on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 153 the buffer_view card should flip to PRESENT and the count grow — re-verify then.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status and list are aria-live; state is textual on every card.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the real language-feature set enumerated on Chromium 141 with buffer_view honestly absent and its consequence for the requires directive stated. Clean console at both viewports.
